# Private GitHub import

Imported on 2026-09-09 as a clean initial source snapshot. Local Git history, personal configuration, runtime/account snapshots, usage history, raw conversations, development caches and installed environments are not included.

Source baseline: `69f6be1d5912cb12c32c1356a8f626cd89e327dc` from the locally verified Quanta RC4 release. This baseline hash refers to the original local repository, not an ancestor in this newly created repository. Application/build input files are unchanged. The import adds this note and stronger local-data ignore rules.

Before upload, the current source and reachable local history passed the known-value privacy scan; the source also passed checks for private-key blocks, common provider/GitHub credential formats, JWTs and personal paths. The reviewed release archive and embedded executable passed the known-value/path scan. The 20 pinned Windows build dependencies had no known vulnerabilities reported by pip-audit on the audit date. These checks do not establish absolute safety or the absence of all possible secrets.

RC4 validation from 2026-09-08: 139 tests passed and eight frozen-EXE acceptance checks passed, including authenticated API access and actual flyout/panel rendering. The existing security audit and release notes describe their original audit dates and scope.

The attached Windows portable package is an unsigned prerelease. Publisher signing and independent clean-device acceptance remain incomplete. Source availability does not imply macOS runtime validation.
